ending.ending_bankrupt.hint: the office ran out of money before the road did.
ending.ending_break_the_chain.hint: someone else was driving — and you let the charges stand, with the records whole.
ending.ending_accountability.hint: you stayed, you called, you said it was you, and you gave them everything.
ending.ending_collapse.hint: you held on to power until there was no institution left to hold.
ending.ending_untouchable.hint: the reports vanished, the intervention held, and you were still standing at the top.
ending.ending_protected.hint: you said nothing, and the office kept you — for a while.
ending.ending_too_late.hint: you confessed. The minutes on the roadside had already been spent.
ending.ending_scapegoat.hint: someone was shielded, and by then you had too little power to be worth shielding.
ending.ending_open_file.hint: someone else was driving; you let the case proceed — with what they could find.
ending.ending_arrangement.hint: someone else was driving, and you kept it inside the room.
ending.ending_statement.hint: you said the words, and then let the lawyers say the rest.
ending.ending_settled.hint: nothing was proven and nothing was cleared, and the term ran out.
ending.ending_open_file.title: The Open File
ending.ending_open_file.text: The case went forward on the records they could find. The trial named the driver, and the sentence was real; the file behind it had holes shaped like your drawer. Nobody asked you to testify. Nobody had to.
ending.ending_arrangement.title: The Arrangement
ending.ending_arrangement.text: The Mentor retired in the spring, for reasons of health, with a dinner. The family received a sum and a letter with no names in it. You kept the office. Some evenings the road comes back to you as a sound, and you turn up the radio.
ending.ending_statement.title: The Statement
ending.ending_statement.text: You said it was you, on the record, in the first week. Then the lawyers said the rest, and the rest took two years and left very little of the first week standing. She lived. You were not in the courtroom when it ended; you were told by phone.
ending.ending_settled.title: Settled
ending.ending_settled.text: There was a settlement, and a review, and a term that ran out on schedule. Nothing was proven; nothing was cleared. Her name appears in one archived article, and yours in the paragraph beneath it, spelled correctly.
card.act0_inherited_staff.text: The office comes with people in it: the outgoing chief of staff, two schedulers, a driver who knows every side entrance in the district. The Aide waits until they have left the room. "They're good. They're also *his*. You can keep the machine, or you can build one that answers to you — that takes a week we don't have."
card.act0_inherited_staff.left: Keep the office as it was.
card.act0_first_petition.text: Seven in the morning, and a delegation is already in the corridor: five people from the flooded district, a folder of photographs, no appointment. The party breakfast starts at seven-thirty, and *the people who decide committee seats will be at it.* The delegation stands up when they see you.
card.act0_ministry_photo.text: "One photograph, and it follows you for a term," the Press Officer says. The ministry atrium is booked; the Mentor has offered to stand beside you. Or: the constituency office, the flooded district behind you, no one from the capital in the frame. *Both are true. Only one gets printed.*
card.act0_ministry_photo.left: The photo at the constituency office.
card.act0_briefing_binder.text: The transition binder is four hundred pages: contracts, pending audits, a list of "sensitivities" with no explanations. The Aide has written a nine-page summary and left both on the desk. It is eleven at night. "The summary is what you'll be asked about," the Aide says. "*The rest is what you'll be blamed for.*"
card.act0_predecessor_call.text: Your predecessor calls on the second evening, warm, unhurried, from a number the office does not have. "No advice. Context. Who owes whom, which doors stick, which ones only *look* locked. One dinner." A pause. "You'll learn it anyway. This way it costs you a Thursday."
card.act0_predecessor_call.right: Decline. You'll form your own view.
card.act0_private_dinner_invitation.text: An envelope with no letterhead. A private dinner: eight names, three of which you have only ever seen on television. No agenda is mentioned. You told the Mentor independence mattered more. *This is where that gets tested first.*

An envelope with no letterhead. A private dinner: eight names, three of which you have only ever seen on television. No agenda is mentioned. You told the press reform requires cooperation. *Here is the cooperation.*
card.act1_committee_opportunity.text.v_p: "The Budget Oversight seat opens next week," your mentor says. "You promised them major change; a seat is where change gets a vote. The selection process is a formality — *if the right person mentions your name.* Shall I?"
card.act1_committee_opportunity.text.v_m: "The Budget Oversight seat opens next week," your mentor says. "You kept your first speech modest. Good — modest people are given seats quietly. The process is a formality — *if the right person mentions your name.* Shall I?"
card.act1_first_promotion.text.v_network: The call comes on a Tuesday: deputy chair of the committee. The official letter cites your legislative record. The unofficial version has two other names in it, and *neither of them is yours.*
card.act1_first_promotion.text.v_clean: The call comes on a Tuesday: deputy chair of the committee. The official letter cites your legislative record, and for once *the unofficial version says the same thing.*
card.act2_minister_intro.text.v_referred: "Your mentor speaks well of you," the Minister says, not looking up from his papers. "He speaks well of very few people." Then he does look up. "*Useful is a beginning.* Sit down."
card.act2_minister_intro.text.v_cold: "Nobody speaks for you," the Minister says, not looking up from his papers. "That is either a problem or a qualification." Then he does look up. "*Useful is a beginning.* Sit down."
card.act2_housing_budget.text.v_fasttrac: Two lines in the same budget: a landmark cultural complex the cameras love, and maintenance for public housing blocks nobody photographs. Last year you fast-tracked the drainage because waiting was cruel. *This year the cameras are here.* There is money for one.
card.act2_housing_budget.text.v_reviewed: Two lines in the same budget: a landmark cultural complex the cameras love, and maintenance for public housing blocks nobody photographs. You once made a drainage project wait for its review. *Nobody photographs a review either.* There is money for one.
card.act2_second_promotion.text.v_by_min: There is no phone call this time. There is a communiqué with your name in the third paragraph, a new office with a view of the river, and a note in the Minister's hand: *"As discussed."* You do not remember discussing it. Nobody asks whether you accept.
card.act2_second_promotion.text.v_earned: There is no phone call this time. There is a communiqué with your name in the third paragraph, a new office with a view of the river, and — for once — nobody you owe for it. *That is rarer than the office.* Nobody asks whether you accept.
